messages:
emily_sales: Quick sync — Novatech asks to add their AP subsidiary as an invoicing + signing entity on the order form and wants a short AML/sanctions line in the MSA. They want legal + AP to sign. Any blockers?

raja_legal: We can do a one-page addendum listing both entities and scoped AML (transaction screening only). Need exact legal names + tax IDs. Avoid expanding indemnities or shifting caps.

marta_procure: Procurement: PO must be on the order form. We also need billing contact and remit address for the subsidiary. Finance prefers Net30; they requested Net60.

ken_eng: Operational hard stop: Dedicated POC provisioning requires the DPA amendment listing the subsidiary before we share VPN/console creds. Can't provision without it.

zoe_cs: Customer prefers HSM-backed signatures but will accept DocuSign today if we include a clause to migrate signatures later. Is migration supported?

security-bot: We support HSM/KMS-backed signing for Dedicated/Private under enterprise add-on. Migration clause ok; add requirement for attestation when switching.

raja_legal: I'll draft addendum + DPA patch. Proposed clause: "Interim e-signature via DocuSign permitted; parties may migrate to HSM-backed signature workflow upon mutual written agreement, with attestation for chain of custody."

marta_procure: Please include `PO required: yes` and route invoices to ap@novatech.subs.example. We'll also need VAT/EIN for tax mapping.

emily_sales: I'll ask Novatech for subsidiary legal name + tax id + billing contact and update here. Also confirm whether split-signing (EU legal signs MSA, US AP signs order form) is acceptable.

esign-bot: created envelope env-1802-novatech-order (DocuSign)  awaiting signatures.

emily_sales: Novatech replied: "Novatech Europe Ltd" VAT GB111222333; billing ap-eu@novatech.example. Subsidiary legal string ok.

raja_legal: thanks. drafting now. will attach redline PR in ~60 minutes. tagging @marta_procure for PO language.

marta_procure: Confirmed: include `Billing contact: ap-eu@novatech.example; PO required; Remit: 12 Market St, London`. Net30 default; escalate to credit for Net60.

ken_eng: once DPA amendment signed, tag infra and we can flip provisioning. Holding preflight until signed, but will queue infra steps.

zoe_cs: I'll tell buyer DocuSign is OK for now and we have HSM migration clause. Keep me posted.

emily_sales: Closing checklist: 1) Novatech tax + billing (received) 2) addendum + DPA draft (raja) 3) PO field added to order form (marta) 4) DocuSign envelope live (esign-bot) 5) gating: no POC creds until DPA signed (ken).
